5. I have heard learned counsel for tthe he parties and gone through the paper-book paper book as well as records of the case.
6. There is no evidence led by the appellants/ landowners in order to support their claim for enhancement of compensation.
As per the records, sufficient opportunity was afforded tto o the appellants/landowners, however, they failed to produce any material evidence on record.
In such circumstances, finding no illegality or perversity with the award dated 06.04.1995 passed by the learned Reference Court, the present appeal being devoid of merit, is thus dismissed.
